title: RetrievalEvalQuestion
description: One row of eval/retrieval/questions.jsonl. The Phase 3.2 retrieval eval scores each question against the chunked corpus by hit@1 / hit@5 / MRR; a chunk counts as a hit when its (doc_id, page_range) intersects the expected span and it contains all expected_span_keywords.

id.description: Sequential id like 'q001'. Stable across edits; never recycle.

question.description: Natural-language question a clinician might ask.

expected_doc_id.description: doc_id of the source document containing the answer.

expected_span_keywords.description: Keywords that must appear in a retrieved chunk's text for it to count as a hit. Case-insensitive substring match. Pick discriminative phrases, not common words.

rationale.description: Why this question was chosen; what the right answer looks like.

source_phase.description: Phase that authored the question. 3.1 ships the seed; 3.2 expands to 50.

requires_full_corpus.description: If true, the question targets the real RACGP/NVDPA PDFs and is skipped in --use-fixture mode.
